cards.claim: Philip Proctor received the Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 1923.
cards.answer: Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire
cards.quote: His dedication to the betterment of New Zealand's industrial landscape did not go unnoticed, and in 1923, he was recognized for his outstanding contributions with the prestigious award of Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire. This esteemed honor, conferred upon Proctor by King George V, was a testament to his tireless efforts in promoting the growth and development of New Zealand's industries. The Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire, a rank within the Order of the British Empire, is one of the highest honors bestowed upon individuals for their exceptional service to the Commonwealth.
